notes.title: Update is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
The update is up and running.
With the update the game became a few times bigger.  

Featuring:

-Male Locker room with 2 characters who make comments
-Bathroom with a lot of characters who make comments and somehow react to the player
-Player home. 
-2 City scenes.
-Money. Being Spent on bus and protein.
-Competitions. Very basic stuff, but a sure way to get money. 
-Bus ride. If player doesn't have money - the player will have to walk on his own and this drains stamina and reduces player weight.
-Fights. Very basic, ability to fight with the black market seller.
-Hospital scene. If you lose in a fight you get to a hospital, lose reputation and muscles
-Sleep ability. When you stamina is zero you can refill it by sleeping.
-2 Sellers. Legit shop and black market. 
-Ability to have a shower.
Think how you would take it in real life. If you are not attentive enough, you may lose reputation
-Protein affecting muscle growth. It is a timed bonus. Whenever you buy protein, for 60 seconds you get a bonus to muscle growth when exercising.
-Chinese localization.
95% of texts have been translated. Please note that Chinese translation was done using we all know which website.
If you have any suggestions for correcting the translation please write in discussions.
-Peck Dec Machine 
-Pull machine 
-1 dumbbell exercise
-New music
-Voiced NPC's
-Dude whose head is stuck in a toilet
-Protein craft
-Male toilet
-2 easter eggs in dialogues
-Bug fixes
-A few new small bugs(Grunting sound effect randomly disappears, some stamina and clothing related bugs, unpolished pull machine animation, etc) that I am aware of but wasn't able to fix in time. Will fix in the next iteration.

notes.title: Interjacent Update Available
notes.content:
[h1][b]VR support[/b]. [/h1]
You can now be in Gym in VR and walk around.  Advanced features support for VR are being worked on.
-Punching bag physics have been added
-Working weight meter showing players weight. 
-Bigger growth possibilities
-Basic gamepad support(walking)
-Major bug fixes
-Smoother muslce growth
-Leg muscle growth
-2 separate muscle groups
-Squats only affect leg muscles
-4 new achievements

Upd:
Bench press exercise added.
